case_title.quote: CHHOTA AHIRWAR v. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH

number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant's liability is decided; the main accused's merits are expressly left open.

accused_gender.quote: the accused appellant stopped him on the way
accused_gender.reason: No clear gender statement for the appellant; the pronouns refer to others.

accused_caste.reason: No caste is stated; the surname alone is not a statement.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation is stated; only that land was given for cultivation.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is stated for the accused.

victim_gender.quote: the accused appellant exhorted the main accused Khilai to kill him

accused_victim_relationship.quote: The accused appellant, the main accused, Khilai, and the complainant were all related.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Relatives with a land dispute and enmity, as stated.

offence_category.quote: attempt, with common intent along with the main accused Khilai, to murder the complainant
offence_category.reason: The charge is s.307 attempt to murder.

statutory_provisions.quote: charges under Section 307/34 of the Indian Penal Code

weapon.quote: fire at the complainant with a country made pistol
weapon.reason: The country-made pistol was used by the main accused.

evidence_type.quote: Of the eleven witnesses examined by the Prosecution
evidence_type.reason: Accurately lists the eyewitness, medical, IO and hostile witness evidence.

confession.quote: They also denied that the main accused Khilai had made any confession.
confession.reason: The alleged confession was denied and not relied on.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: It is not in dispute that the accused appellant neither carried arms nor opened fire.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for five years in addition to fine of Rs.1000/-

final_outcome.quote: The accused appellant is acquitted and directed to be set free forthwith.

fine_rs.reason: The fine was set aside with the conviction.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary, but the land was the uncle's share given to the accused for cultivation, adjacent to the victim's land, and gendered pronouns for the co-accused should be avoided.
neutral_facts.quote: had given his share of land to the accused appellant for cultivation
neutral_facts.reason: Land ownership framing is loose and pronouns are used for the co-accused; no outcome leakage.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the s.307 punishment.

physical_harm.quote: sustained injuries on his forehead near his eye and on his lips and shoulder with splinters

motive.quote: There were land disputes between members of the family
motive.reason: Alleged land dispute; no motive was found.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: These facts are corroborated by PW-3 (the Complainant) and PW-4.

witness_credibility.quote: notable discrepancies between the evidence of the complainant (PW-3) and PW-4 which raise serious doubts

post_offence_conduct.quote: the accused Khilai fled the scene of occurrence and the accused appellant followed him

legal_representation.quote: Saurabh Mishra and P. V. Yogeswaran, Advs. for the Appellant.

investigation_status.quote: Crime No.110/1992 was registered ... Chargesheet was filed

prosecution_argument.reason: Arguments before the Supreme Court are not recorded.

defence_argument.reason: Arguments before the Supreme Court are not recorded.

legal_principle_applied.quote: Common intention implies acting in concert.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: B.N. Srikantiah vs. Siddiah reported in AIR 1958 SC 672

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Accused directed to be set free forthwith; Court did not consider the main accused's case, whose appeal is to be decided on its own merits.
other_sentence_order.quote: directed to be set free forthwith. It is made clear that this Court has not considered the merits of the conviction of the main accused Khilai
other_sentence_order.reason: The Court gave a release direction and a clarification, so 'None' is incomplete.
